# Business Registration Pakistan

> Independent Karachi consultancy and free guides for tax filing (NTN, income tax returns, filer status, sales tax, FBR notices), company registration with SECP, and trademark registration with IPO-Pakistan. Pages are written to answer practical questions directly and show their last update date.

Business Registration Pakistan is not affiliated with FBR, SECP or IPO-Pakistan. Figures such as tax slabs and fees change with each Finance Act or notification, so each guide points to the official source (iris.fbr.gov.pk, secp.gov.pk, ipo.gov.pk). Where published sources disagree, the guide says so.

- [SMC (single member company) registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/smc-registration-pakistan.html): SMC registration in Pakistan: one owner, limited liability, the nominee requirement, documents and how an SMC compares with a sole proprietorship.
- [LLP registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/llp-registration-pakistan.html): LLP registration in Pakistan with SECP: limited liability for partners, how it compares with a partnership firm and a private limited company, and who it suits.
- [Partnership firm registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/partnership-registration.html): Partnership firm registration in Pakistan: partnership deed, Registrar of Firms filing, NTN as an AOP, unlimited liability and when an LLP is safer.
- [Sole proprietorship registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/sole-proprietorship-registration.html): Sole proprietorship registration in Pakistan: no SECP filing, register an NTN with FBR, personal liability, tax filing and when to switch to an SMC.
- [Foreign company registration in Pakistan](https://businessregistrationpakistan.com/foreign-company-registration-pakistan.html): Foreign company registration in Pakistan: how overseas founders and foreign nationals can incorporate with SECP, what documents differ and what to check first.
